sections.line: Three things per site, three options, a request folder, plan and apply, credentials, public by default, agents.

sections.label: The question
sections.line: Every site needs a repository, a record and a vault, starting with the Web Summit team site.
sections.para: How to go from a commit to a live link.

sections.label: Three options
sections.line: By hand, scripts or a CLI, or a CI pipeline.
sections.para: Only the pipeline needs no person with the keys.

sections.label: A request is a folder
sections.line: A folder per request: site.json, brief.md, and status.json written back by CI.
sections.para: Every site has its own history.

sections.label: Plan, then apply

sections.label: Credentials worth trusting
sections.line: A GitHub App, AWS through OpenID Connect, secrets only for sgit and Claude.

sections.line: The pipeline has its own policy: one org, two zones, labels by pattern, a daily limit.
sections.para: It can create; only teardown removes.

sections.label: Public by default
sections.line: The factory and its record are public; only the credentials are not.
